property_summary: For any non-empty transfer call with more than one recipient, the call to the last recipient's address must succeed and be recorded; the buggy version reverts when all recipients equal each other and the last one does not revert, because it never actually calls the last token. More precisely, if every recipient is the same address A and A's transferFrom succeeds, the correct contract completes and calls A exactly _tos.length times, whereas the mutant skips index 0, still succeeds but makes fewer calls; a recorder observing the number of calls to A distinguishes them for _tos.length > 1.
change_summary: Change the loop initialization from i = 0 to i = 1, skipping the first token transfer and reducing the number of external calls, which changes observable behavior for non-empty _tos arrays.
